root_cause: Production Release Readback used cancel-in-progress correctly but exposed no workflow_dispatch. When a newer main commit superseded a running browser proof, the older job could finish with cancelled/skipped functional steps and the newer non-deployment commit could skip browser proof entirely. Exact-main functional proof then required another repository mutation.
prevention_rule: Terminal production proof must be explicitly re-runnable on current main without product-code mutation. Manual readback always requires deployment identity and /prijzen browser interaction proof.
failed_approaches: Treating a successful job shell with cancelled route verification and skipped pricing/i18n steps as terminal proof.
Relying on the next main push to re-run the same browser gate even when that push is classified non-deployment.

evidence.skipped_step: Verify pricing interactions and English route in production

invariants: manual exact-main readback forces browser proof
